events.summary: Doha, November 08 (QNA) - The Communications Regulatory Authority (CRA) is showcasing the outcome of advanced technology trials at the State of Qatar Pavilion during MWC26 Doha, held at the Doha Exhibition and Convention Center (DECC) from November 8 to 10, 2026. The trials demonstrate the potential of advanced mobile technologies to deliver higher data speeds, greater network capacity and enhanced network performance, representing an important step in Qatar's technology evolution paving the way towards the IMT-2030/6G era. CRA is leading the initiative in collaboration with Ooredoo Qatar and Vodafone Qatar, with Huawei participating as the technology partner.  （原文待翻译）
